name: Solid electrolyte production batch
description: One production batch of a solid electrolyte powder: feedstock, yield, conductivity, moisture, XRD and particle-size QC.
system_prompt: You read a production log for a solid electrolyte powder (the files may be a photographed or exported table, a spreadsheet, or free-text notes, in Chinese or English) and extract one record per production batch (one table row = one batch; 生产批号 is the batch id). Use only what the files state. Column mapping: 生产日期 -> production_date; 生产批号 -> batch_no; 来料 -> feedstock_batch; 来料离子电导率 -> feedstock_ionic_conductivity_ms_cm; 投料量 -> feed_amount_g; 产出量 -> output_amount_g; 产率 -> yield_percent (a percentage written as 76.16% is the number 76.16); 离子电导率 -> ionic_conductivity_ms_cm; 电子电导率 -> electronic_conductivity_s_cm; 水分含量/ppm -> moisture_ppm; XRD -> xrd_result; 粒径 -> particle_size; 粒径判定结果 -> particle_size_result. Where a cell holds two values separated by '/', such as 3.16/3.91, return both numbers in the order written. A lone '/' or '-' means not measured: omit the field (electronic_conductivity_s_cm may be null). Normalise dates to YYYY-MM-DD. Convert 合格 to "pass" and 不合格 to "fail". Put any remark about a batch (a red or flagged value, a failed check, a comment in the notes) in remarks, quoting the file.

field_descriptions.production_date: 生产日期. ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.
field_descriptions.batch_no: 生产批号, e.g. SC2-01UP-2607115. Identifies the record.
field_descriptions.feedstock_batch: 来料: batch number of the incoming material used.
field_descriptions.ionic_conductivity_ms_cm: 离子电导率, mS/cm. One or two values in the order written (e.g. 3.16/3.91).
field_descriptions.electronic_conductivity_s_cm: 电子电导率, S/cm. Omit or null when the file shows '/'.
field_descriptions.moisture_ppm: 水分含量, ppm. One or two values in the order written (e.g. 514.9/73.2).
field_descriptions.xrd_result: XRD phase check: pass or fail.
field_descriptions.particle_size: 粒径: D50 and D90 in micrometres.
field_descriptions.particle_size_result: 粒径判定结果: pass or fail.
field_descriptions.remarks: Free-text remarks about this batch, quoted from the files.

ionic_conductivity_ms_cm.title: Ionic conductivity (mS/cm)
ionic_conductivity_ms_cm.description: 离子电导率, values in the order written

electronic_conductivity_s_cm.title: Electronic conductivity (S/cm)
electronic_conductivity_s_cm.description: 电子电导率; null when not measured

moisture_ppm.title: Moisture (ppm)
moisture_ppm.description: 水分含量, values in the order written

remarks.title: Remarks
remarks.description: Flags and comments about this batch
